title: Akbar tu kahan hai
body:
kehti hai sahar gham ki akbar tu kahan hai
sajde bhi hai afsurda betaab azaan hai
akbar tu kahan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaadi ka teri waqt hai ya waqt e shahadat
sehra hai duaon ka aur maa ki zaban hai
akbar tu kahan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ladiyan tere sehre ki choome tere seene ko
afsos magar tere seene may sina hai
akbar tu kahan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aur iske siwa kya hai islam ka daaman may
ek sajda hai ek zarbat aur ek azaan hai
akbar tu kahan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai pyaas ke aalam may akbar ko ajal aayi
aur saamne aankhon ke darya bhi rawan hai
akbar tu kahan hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan ye kehti thi maadar ali akbar ki
kya darr hai layeeno ka mera laal jawan hai
akbar tu kahan hai...
author: Rehaan Azmi
